profile.name: Tecan自动液体处理工作站
profile.description: 这是一类用于实验室自动移液和样品处理的液体处理工作站。设备在工作台甲板上放置载架、孔板、试剂槽、比色皿、磁力模块和一次性吸头架，并通过自动吸液、分液、换头和废弃处理完成样品制备、试剂分装、PCR体系构建等流程。
profile.description_en: This is an automated liquid handling workstation used for laboratory pipetting and sample processing. The instrument arranges carriers, microplates, reagent troughs, cuvettes, magnetic modules, and disposable tip racks on a deck, and performs aspiration, dispensing, tip changes, and waste handling for tasks such as sample preparation, reagent distribution, and PCR setup.

registry.description: Liquid Classes是一款移液工作站，主要功能包括写入数据、初始化、日志记录、电流设置、电流读取、运动控制。支持Signal, Slot, actions等操作。
